title: Lunchline draw rule
description: A 1px hairline along the top or bottom edge of a band that draws itself out from the middle (86% to full width) as it scrolls into view. CSS only.
notes: the line ends its draw a third of the way up the window, so on a page's very last band it can stop just short of full width
name: lunchline-draw-rule

props.name: edge
props.description: where the line sits in its (relative) parent: along the top edge or the bottom edge

props.name: className
props.description: colour and thickness overrides (bg-border h-px by default)
